contains: bounded source excerpts and evidence snippets
scan timing, health, and degradation metadata

ephemeral_mode.behavior: uses a temporary output directory for scan index/cache state and deletes it on command exit; no canonical artifact directory is written

git_safety.rule: Generated .davinci-style directories ignore all contents except the guard .gitignore unless an operator intentionally force-adds reviewed artifacts.

hosted_boundary: This local CLI policy does not define hosted or CI artifact retention. CI uploads, sync providers, and hosted services need separate retention settings.
